purpose: Review only C4 RETIREMENT_REVIEW nodes through separate logical-retirement and repository-deletion-readiness gates. C5 may approve candidates for a later owner-specific C6 handoff but never deletes files.

gateA.name: LOGICAL_RETIREMENT_ELIGIBILITY
allOf: explicit successor declaration OR explicit retirement approval
gateA.retentionSignalSource: C3 primaryLifecycle/classificationBasis/secondaryReasons only; no filename, stage, date, or chronology inference.
gateA.retirementApprovalPolicy: Only exact machine-readable declarations enumerated in this contract may qualify. The current contract enumerates none, so no approval is inferred from prose, COMPLETE/FROZEN status, age, stage number, DEPRECATED/SUPERSEDED wording, or filename.

retirementApprovalDeclarationSchema.approved: boolean true only; false/omitted does not qualify
retirementApprovalDeclarationSchema.note: Current declarations array is empty. Adding a declaration is a C5 contract change and refresh trigger.

gateB.name: REPOSITORY_DELETION_READINESS
allOf: exactly one explicit Project Check owner resolves for the candidate path
at least one catalogued validator exists for that owner
a validator id is explicitly admitted as deletion-safe and read-only by this C5 contract
totalReferenceCount == 0 so deletion leaves no current exact-path reference edge dangling
Project Check owner rule ids are non-empty
automatic validation is fail-closed and leaves tracked repository state unchanged
gateB.deletionSafetyPolicy: Do not infer deletion safety from validator names, coverage prose, successful non-deletion validation, or generic routing. A validator must be explicitly admitted here after owner-specific deletion-safety evidence exists.

refreshWhen: C4 retentionPartitionDigest or RETIREMENT_REVIEW membership changes.
A C3 explicit successor/retention signal changes for a C5 candidate.
An exact retirement-approval declaration is added to this C5 contract.
Project Check owner routing or validator catalog changes for a Gate A eligible candidate.
C2 exact-path reference edges change for a Gate A eligible candidate.
freshness.incrementalPolicy: Re-evaluate only affected RETIREMENT_REVIEW candidates and any owner-readiness records impacted by changed routing/validator declarations.

handoff.whenDeleteApprovedCountPositive: C6 Cleanup Apply, split into owner-specific deletion batches.
handoff.whenDeleteApprovedCountZero: C6_NOT_OPENED; C5 remains complete and may be incrementally refreshed when explicit successor/retirement approval or deletion-readiness evidence changes.
